propositions: When acceptance criteria become invalid due to subsequent code changes, the completion verifier blocks closure with no legitimate path other than --force-close or --ref to old commits, both of which leave inaccurate ticket state
The correct remediation for stale acceptance criteria is to edit the ticket, re-pass plan review, and close against corrected criteria, but this workflow is undocumented

The --ref flag is a legitimate close path for criteria invalidated by later work (verifying against the commit where the work landed), but this usage pattern is not documented as an official escape hatch
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check forces re-review of already-executed plans when the criteria registry changes, stranding completed merged work behind a full billable review cycle
Auto-generated or unverifiable acceptance criteria and automation-owned alert tickets have no legitimate closure paths at any commit reference
